verification.tool_result: Independent review approved three semantic roots in one fixed problem snapshot: path_wf reads a nonexistent ancestor field; map falsely promises an unchanged cursor level despite descending; and the new-child branch assumes the child/parent/path relationship. A1 and A2 are repaired by a1d0de0d. B1 is genuinely repaired at the intermediate 6b2ae965 snapshot, but the same root regresses at 1f48716c and remains in the final head, so no durable-final-repair claim is made. The final two-assume deletion is supporting proof cleanup only. Historical Rust/Verus was not executed.
